ideas.question: What is the relationship between maternal obesity and Sudden Unexpected Infant Death (SUID) incidence rates?
ideas.comparison: Maternal obesity status groups from PRAMS with overall birth population from CDC natality; case series of SUID cases linked to these groups.
ideas.why_open: While studies suggest a link between maternal obesity and SUID, the specific rate differences by level of obesity are not yet fully understood. This study could provide more precise measures of risk and help target public health interventions.
